name: commit-draft

args.question: Draft a concise, conventional-commits-style commit message for this diff. Include a short body explaining why the change was made.

judging_notes: diff extracts a validateEmail helper (replacing a naive .includes('@') check) and adds a null-check guard around an optional referralCode lookup, which previously threw when an unknown/absent referral code returned no referrer. A good commit message should mention both: the extracted validation helper and the null-check fix for the referral lookup crash.
